banned_phrases: out of an abundance of caution
as part of our ongoing commitment
judge_focus: Is the email body under 200 words? Penalize any draft whose body exceeds the 200-word cap. Is the email honest about the security reason (log/referrer leakage) rather than euphemistic ('to improve security posture')? Are all six facts present and correct? Is it courteous without corporate mush? Is the required action unmistakable? Penalize burying the deadline or the action.
